{{Quote|I would like to express my extreme gratitude to Chief Balunta for bringing the ''Bazaar'' to use.|[[Thurm Loogg]]|<ref name="Shadows in Green">{{LivingForce|Shadows in Green}}</ref>}}
[[Chief/Legends|Chief]] '''Balunta''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. He commanded the [[Ithorian Herdship|Ithorian herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']] when it traveled to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].
